name: EventCalendar
description: A month of days with the events on each day. Choose a day to select it; move between months with the arrows. Days are buttons, so the calendar works with the keyboard.
whenToUse: To show meetings, deadlines or launches across a month.
To let people pick a date and see what is on it.

whenNotToUse.text: To pick a date for a form field.
For a range of dates in a form.

anatomy.name: Header
anatomy.description: The month name and previous / next buttons.

anatomy.name: Weekdays
anatomy.description: Short day names across the top.

anatomy.name: Day
anatomy.description: A button with the date; shows today and the selected day.

anatomy.name: Event chip
anatomy.description: An event on its day, coloured by tone.

anatomy.name: Agenda
anatomy.description: The day view: the events of one day, with times.

values.meaning: Default. The whole month, with up to two events per day.
The seven days of the week that holds the selected day, with every event and its time.
An agenda of the selected day.
Default. Shows the month name and previous / next buttons.
Hidden, when the page has its own toolbar.

states.name: Outside
states.meaning: Days from the previous or next month.

states.name: Focus
states.meaning: A ring on the focused day.

behavior.text: Pressing a day calls onSelectDate; the day is announced with its events.
The arrows call onMonthChange with the first day of the new month.
Up to two events show on a day; the rest show as a count.
An event with an end date shows on every day it covers.
With onSelectEvent, each event is a button; pressing it calls the handler with the event.
Choose the first day of the week with weekStartsOn (Monday by default).

content: Name each event in a few words, e.g. "Design review".
Use the locale prop for month and weekday names in other languages.

guidelines.do: Show the event title on the day.
guidelines.why: Titles say what is happening; dots need a legend.

guidelines.do: Keep event colours to a few tones with clear meanings.
guidelines.dont: Give every event its own colour.
guidelines.why: Too many colours make the calendar hard to read.

guidelines.do: Choose the week start your audience expects.
guidelines.dont: Start every week on Sunday everywhere.
guidelines.why: Calendars should match how people count weeks.

accessibility.role: group named by label, containing a grid of weekday headers and day cells.

keyboard.action: Moves between the month buttons and the days.

aria.when: On each day, true for the selected day.
On each day: its full date and how many events it has.

accessibility.focus: The focused day shows a focus ring.

wcag.how: Weekdays are column headers; days are grid cells.
Focus is shown on every day and button.
Each day is named by its date and event count.

notes: Event chips are hidden from assistive technology; the day’s label gives their count.

examples.title: Team calendar
examples.description: A month with a few events.

examples.title: Controlled month
examples.description: The month and selection live in your state.
examples.code:
import { EventCalendar } from '@ds/react';

<EventCalendar label="Launches" month={month} onMonthChange={setMonth} selectedDate={day} onSelectDate={setDay} events={events} />

examples.title: Week starts on Sunday
examples.description: For audiences that count weeks from Sunday.
examples.code:
import { EventCalendar } from '@ds/react';

<EventCalendar label="Schedule" month={new Date()} weekStartsOn={0} />

related.relation: For picking a single date in a form.

changes: New component: month view; week and day views; multi-day events; onSelectEvent; header.

components.name: EventCalendar
components.description:
A calendar with month, week and day views. An event shows on each day it covers; choose a day
to select it, and press an event to open it when onSelectEvent is set. Days are buttons, so the
calendar works with the keyboard.

month.description: Any date in the month to show.

view.description: `month` (default) shows the whole month; `week` the week of the selected day; `day` its agenda.

header.description: Shows the month name and previous / next buttons. Turn off when the page has its own.

onSelectEvent.description: Called with an event when its chip is pressed. Makes the chips buttons.

onMonthChange.description: Called with the first day of the month when the arrows are pressed.

weekStartsOn.description: Day the week starts on: 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday (default).

locale.description: Locale for month and weekday names. Default "en-US".
